purpose: Pilot B: do small-data regularizers improve target-only IQL and BC on 5000 target transitions? Screening only (5 seeds).
authorized_by_user: 2026-11-15: pilot B; all four GPUs may be used when nobody else is using them, no per-card process limit imposed by the cluster
learner: frozen network classes and loss functions (iql_dyn.py, iql_unc.py); IQL: gamma 0.99, tau 0.005, expectile 0.7, temperature 10, lr 3e-4, hidden 256, batch 64, policy cosine schedule; BC: lr 3e-4, hidden 256, batch 64, cosine schedule; raw observations and rewards; same as the earlier T and BC-all runs except for seeds and random streams
sparse_definition: score |w * dL/dw| per Linear weight, each network with its own loss on a separate 256-sample batch, all of that network's connections active while scoring; global top 5% per network, at least 1% of each layer kept; biases never masked; pruned weights keep their value and may return at a later refresh; target Q uses the Q mask; masks set before step 1 and refreshed every 5000 steps up to step 200000. Follows the description in arXiv 2506.17155; choices the paper leaves open are ours and were not checked against the authors' code.

rule.metric: Last5 = mean of the last five evaluation points, 10 episodes each
rule.effective: paired difference against the same learner's base (same seeds): mean > 0 and mean > 2 * paired SE
rule.worth_confirming: effective and the variant mean >= max(base IQL mean, base BC mean) on that task
rule.status: screening with 5 seeds; a confirmation with new seeds is required before any claim

failure_policy: A run killed by a signal is restarted from step 0 with the same seed and config in a new folder, at most 3 times. A Python error, NaN/Inf or failed audit stops new launches and is reported. Returns are never used to decide a retry.
